about.heading: Taking Pride in Every Job
paragraphs: Set Right Tiling was built from a passion for the tiling trade and a commitment to quality workmanship.

With 12 years of experience in the industry and seven years running the business, I believe that doing a job properly, paying attention to the finer details and treating every home with respect are what make a good tradesman.
For me, it's not just about laying tiles. It's about getting the preparation right, delivering a finish to be proud of and making sure customers are happy with the result.
I value honest communication, reliability and turning up when I say I will. My name and reputation go into every job.
